clue.text: Private meeting's focus for cabinet

parts.note: close can mean private or secretive, as in a close secret

indicators.note: the focus of a word is its centre, so the middle letter of meeting is taken

explanation.surface: A confidential get-together is all about who gets a seat in the government cabinet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cabinet' looks like the political body; here it is a small private room or cupboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A closet is a small room or cupboard, and cabinet in its older sense meant exactly such a private chamber.

clue.text: Superior Italy in match with English

indicators.note: the letter for Italy sits in the word for a match, so in signals containment

parts.note: in darts a leg is one game within a match
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: Italy prove the better side in a football match against England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Superior' is a noun here: a feudal lord to whom service is owed.
explanation.definitionFit: A liege is a feudal overlord, the superior to whom a vassal owed allegiance.

clue.text: Roswell wanting base to take alien order without researching satellite dish

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the rearranged letters go round the satellite
to be put into a foreign order means the letters are rearranged
wanting means lacking, so the letter for base is taken away from the town name

parts.note: e is the base of natural logarithms
the ISS, the International Space Station, is an orbiting research laboratory

explanation.surface: Investigators at Roswell bypass the alien hunt without consulting their satellite dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'base' is E, the base of natural logarithms. 'without' is the old sense, outside. 'satellite dish' is split: the dish alone is the definition, and the satellite is the International Space Station.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss roll is a sponge cake rolled round jam or cream, served as a sweet dish.

clue.text: Something drawn by Titian is layered

parts.note: a drawn match is a tie
Titian is a reddish-gold hair colour named after the painter

explanation.surface: A sketch by the Venetian master Titian is built up in layers of paint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Something drawn' suggests a picture, but it is a game ending level.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiered means arranged in tiers, rows set one above another, so in layers.

clue.text: Gold disc follows rendition of Rita Ora's debut musical composition

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold

indicators.note: a rendition is a new performance, so these letters are played in a fresh order
a debut is a first appearance, so the first letter of Ora is used

parts.note: a disc is round like the letter O

explanation.surface: A gold disc is awarded after Rita Ora's first single is released.
explanation.walkthrough: 'follows' is loose: only the disc follows the rearranged letters, while the gold comes before them.
explanation.definitionFit: An oratorio is a large-scale sacred musical work for voices and orchestra, like Handel's Messiah.

clue.text: Restyled mod band is neater — they accept change

indicators.note: something restyled is given a new arrangement, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A sixties mod band smartens up its look, and that brings a change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' belongs in the letters to be rearranged, not the link it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit machines are fed with coins, loose change, which is what they accept.

clue.text: Perhaps Springbok to run off after six footer

indicators.note: the word for running off comes after the six-legged creature in the answer

parts.note: an ant is an insect with six feet
to elope is to run off secretly to marry

explanation.surface: A tall South African rugby player bolts after a six-foot teammate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Springbok' suggests a rugby player; here it is the animal itself, and a 'six footer' is not a tall man but an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: The springbok is a southern African gazelle, one example of the antelope family.

clue.text: Beyonce first to sing once free — Put A Ring On It follows

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece put on another goes above it, so the ring comes first

parts.note: a ring is a circle, the letter O

indicators.note: once free means the word once is released from the singer's name
the first letter of sing is taken

explanation.surface: Beyoncé, once released, sings her hit Put a Ring on It first.
explanation.walkthrough: The refrain of Beyoncé's Single Ladies is turned into an instruction to place a ring, the letter O, on top of the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To obey someone is to follow their instructions, so obeys and follows are synonyms.

clue.text: Raab, maybe visiting Crete — if constituents agitated, it's not ideal

indicators.note: the politician visits, going inside the rearranged letters
the letters making up the words are stirred up into a new order

parts.note: Dominic Raab is a British Member of Parliament, an MP

explanation.surface: A minister holidays in Crete while his voters back home grow restless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'agitated' rearranges CRETE IF to IERFECT, which the MP goes into. Dominic Raab was criticised for holidaying in Crete during the 2021 Afghanistan crisis.
explanation.definitionFit: Something imperfect has flaws, so it falls short of ideal.

clue.text: Harry Enfield met corruption

indicators.note: to harry is to harass or disturb, so these letters are disturbed

explanation.surface: The comedian Harry Enfield encountered a scandal of corruption.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Harry' looks like the comedian's first name but is a verb meaning harass.
explanation.definitionFit: Defilement is the act of making something impure or tainted, which is corruption.

clue.text: Inside Socrates and Pythagoras' meeting spot

indicators.note: for the two names to meet, the and that keeps them apart has to go
only the letters inside, around the join of the two names, are kept

explanation.surface: Socrates and Pythagoras need a place to meet up.
explanation.walkthrough: The word straddles the join of the two names once 'and' is ignored, which 'meeting' signals: they are run together, end against start.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of, so it is a verb synonym for spot.

clue.text: Bluth covers breaking news: vacuous actor reveals masculine habits

indicators.note: the setter and the empty actor together cover the rearranged word, sitting either side of it

parts.note: the setter refers to himself, ME

indicators.note: vacuous means empty, so only the outer letters of actor remain
the word news is broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A crossword setter covers a breaking story in which a vapid actor exposes his macho ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'habits' means clothing, as in a riding habit, not routines.
explanation.definitionFit: Menswear is clothing for men; a habit is a garment, so masculine habits are men's clothes.

clue.text: Brilliance of good man caught in honey trap

indicators.note: the saint is caught inside the trap

parts.note: a lure is a bait or enticement, as a honey trap is
ST, saint, is a crossword's usual good man

explanation.surface: A virtuous man is ensnared in a seduction sting, and how brilliant it is.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre is shine or radiance, a gloss of brilliance.

clue.text: Register old design

parts.note: a log is a register or record

explanation.surface: Record an old design for posterity.
explanation.definitionFit: A logo is an emblem, a graphic design that identifies a company.

clue.text: Regularly taking volleys — initially most players improve action during school games periods

indicators.note: taking every other letter of volleys at regular intervals
the first letters of the following six words are taken

explanation.surface: Practising volleys regularly helps most players improve during school games lessons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'games periods' suggests PE lessons at school; here it is the four-year spans between Olympic Games.
explanation.definitionFit: An Olympiad is the four-year interval between Olympic Games, so a games period.

clue.text: Due to be sold overseas — or to European Community

indicators.note: or to EC means the word or is turned into the abbreviation, a replacement

parts.note: goods sold abroad are exported
the word or itself as letters

explanation.surface: Goods are due to be exported, perhaps to the European Community.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or to European Community' reads as a destination; it says OR becomes EC.
explanation.definitionFit: Something due is anticipated at a set time, as an expected arrival is.

clue.text: Skilled worker in boat's crew

parts.note: a boat is a craft; with the 's it gives craft's
to man a vessel is to crew it

explanation.surface: A skilled hand serves on the crew of a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A craftsman is an artisan trained in a manual trade, a skilled worker.

clue.text: Hamper from ex-students with one who skipped school about to replace case from Amazon

parts.note: OBs are old boys, former pupils

indicators.note: the letter for about takes the place of the outer letters of Amazon

parts.note: a truant stays away from school without leave

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outside, its first and last letters

parts.note: C, circa, means about

explanation.surface: Old students who once bunked off school hamper an Amazon delivery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hamper' looks like a basket that Amazon might deliver; it is a verb. TRUANT with AN swapped for C gives TRUCT.
explanation.definitionFit: To hamper progress is to hinder or block it, which is to obstruct.

clue.text: Bishop on course that's short and sweet

indicators.note: the bishop goes on the end of the shortened course
short means the course is cut, losing its last letter

parts.note: a syllabus is a course of study
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A bishop's address at the course is brief and pleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short and sweet' is a stock phrase; it splits, so 'sweet' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Syllabub is a frothy dessert of whipped cream, wine and sugar, so a sweet in the British sense of pudding.

clue.text: Completely understand the woman's missing voice

indicators.note: missing means the two words are absent from the longer word

parts.note: altogether means completely
to get something is to understand it
her refers to the woman

explanation.surface: Fully grasping why the woman has lost her singing voice.
explanation.walkthrough: Take GET and HER out of ALTOGETHER to leave ALTO.
explanation.definitionFit: Alto is the lowest female singing voice, a part in choral music.

clue.text: Decorative strip bearing motto in small capitals on mug

parts.note: s.c. is the printer's abbreviation for small capitals
to roll someone is slang for robbing them, as to mug is

explanation.surface: A banner with a motto printed in small capitals on a mug.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry and architecture a scroll is a ribbon-like band, often carrying an inscription.

clue.text: Saatchi's opening with good artist occasionally making animation

indicators.note: the opening letter of Saatchi is taken

parts.note: pi, short for pious, means good

indicators.note: occasionally picks every other letter of artist

explanation.surface: Saatchi's new gallery opening features a good artist who sometimes makes animated films.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirit means liveliness or vigour, and animation is the same quality of being lively.

clue.text: Blended puree with Indian bread

indicators.note: blending mixes things up, so the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A smooth vegetable purée served with naan or chapati.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Indian bread' suggests naan; 'bread' is slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: The rupee is India's currency, and bread is slang for money.

clue.text: Firm breast not completely seen — breaking the watershed — it's stimulating

indicators.note: the firm and the shortened breast break into the watershed

parts.note: on UK television the watershed is 9pm, nine o'clock, after which adult content may air
CO is short for company, a firm

indicators.note: the word for breast is only partly visible, losing its last letter

parts.note: tit is slang for a breast

explanation.surface: A firm breast glimpsed on TV before the 9pm cut-off is quite a thrill.
explanation.walkthrough: COTI goes inside NINE. The UK watershed is the 9pm cut-off before which TV must suit children.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicotine is the addictive stimulant drug found in tobacco.

clue.text: Glaringly obvious, in retrospect — expelling extreme elements of Labour

indicators.note: the outermost letters at each end are thrown out
looking back means reading the word from its end

parts.note: blatant means glaringly obvious

explanation.surface: Looking back, it is glaringly obvious that the Labour Party is purging its extremists.
explanation.walkthrough: TNATALB loses its ends T and B. 'Labour' looks like the political party; it means childbirth.
explanation.definitionFit: Natal means relating to birth, and labour is the process of giving birth.

clue.text: Femme fatale's make up

definitions.meaning: a seductive woman who exploits men
to ..., as in ... up, is to improvise or concoct

explanation.surface: A seductress applying her cosmetics.
explanation.definitionFit: Vamp is short for vampire, a predatory seductress; to vamp something up is to cobble it together.

clue.text: Ultimately you auction Dali off to our museum — Saatchi not happy with lack of diversity

indicators.note: ultimately points to the last letter of each of the following ten words

parts.words: you auction Dali off to our museum — Saatchi not happy

explanation.surface: You sell off your Dalí to our museum, leaving the collector Saatchi unhappy about the monotonous collection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ultimately' seems to apply to 'you' alone, but it takes the final letter of every word up to 'happy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Uniformity is sameness throughout, the absence of variety.

clue.text: Fireproof top carried by online fashion retailer

indicators.note: the word for top is carried within the retailer's name

parts.note: ASOS is a British online clothing retailer
to top is to best, outdo

explanation.surface: A flame-resistant top sold by an internet clothes shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top' looks like a garment from the shop; it is a verb meaning beat.
explanation.definitionFit: Asbestos is a mineral fibre once widely used for its resistance to fire.

clue.text: Isolated — perhaps Messi's lost one yard

indicators.note: lost means one letter has gone missing from the name

parts.note: Lionel Messi's first name, Messi being one example of a Lionel
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Messi has lost a yard of pace and is left isolated up front.
explanation.definitionFit: Lonely can mean remote or solitary, as an isolated place is.
